verdict.rationale: llamafile (via bundled llama.cpp) documents support for GGUF models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi), multimodal image description with models like Qwen3.5/llava, and even a separate whisperfile for speech-to-text, showing broad architecture coverage. However, there's no explicit mention of MoE model support or dedicated embedding-model support, and the 'hundreds of architectures' claim is not directly evidenced—only a handful of named models/architectures appear across docs and community reports. missing for 10: explicit MoE model support, explicit embedding-model support, a comprehensive list confirming 'hundreds' of architectures, independent verification beyond a few named models.
